before15.styles: Instrumental electronic breakbeat, fixed 175 BPM in D Minor, straight 4/4 from the first bar through the final hit. Strong punchy kick and cracking snare carry an unmistakable full-speed running step throughout. A processed piano repeats a clipped eighth-note figure over Dm -> C -> Gm -> A, with a deep synth bass landing each new root. Offbeat snare chops circle a heavy electronic kick, but the full-speed step remains obvious. The expanded theme layers a bright synth response above the piano and doubles the bass drive. Aim for about 3:20.
before15.exclude: vocals, spoken word, jazz, drill, half-time drums, tempo changes, beatless breakdown, ambient intro
before15.title: 15. 번쩍이는 궤도
